title: BRM reproducibility package: From Group Nulls to Person-Specific Recovery
description: Versioned reproducibility package for the methodological manuscript From Group Nulls to Person-Specific Recovery: Statistical Cancellation, Signal Availability, and Design in Intensive Longitudinal Research. The release contains simulation code, deterministic seed maps, canonical Monte Carlo outputs, manuscript tables, figure-generation code, figures, environment information, and validation utilities. Restricted mcPHASES data are not redistributed.
